## Problem and behavior

Related issue: Refs #

Describe the concrete before/after behavior and the agreed scope briefly.
Link the evidence-led plan and why this approach was selected. Record findings
that changed the plan, resolved experiments and any remaining assumptions.

## Verification

Record the candidate, checks actually run and results. Distinguish source/fixture
checks, released artifacts and real runtime/media evidence. Include before/after
visual evidence for UI changes. State failed, blocked and not-run checks.
Distinguish an environment that prevented a check from a check that executed and
failed. Sanitize excerpts; keep raw private evidence outside Git.

## Open acceptance

List remaining criteria, compatibility or integration decisions. Use Fixes # only
when the linked issue's acceptance criteria are met. A prior green branch build
does not establish correctness after conflict resolution or integration.
Name the next acceptance action. Confirm the diff/index contains only this task,
link its candidate and issue evidence, and report publication/CI state accurately.
